parsed.post: The last experiment (val_bpb 0.854057) was slightly worse than our best (0.852968). Increasing depth failed, so I'll return to the best configuration and try fine-tuning the learning rate and weight decay instead. I suspect the optimal balance is closer to our previous successful settings.
